class.name: SuperpositionSpawner
class.brief_description: Automatic authoritative scene spawning, ownership and lifecycle.
class.description: Replicates the membership of allowlisted local scenes. Add below a [SuperpositionWorld], assign [member scenes], and choose [member spawn_path]. The server calls [method spawn]; compatible clients instantiate their own matching scene. Export-stable scene manifests include prefab IDs, local resource identity, node structure, declared script method/property interfaces and nested property schemas. They do not hash script implementation bytes; use game_protocol and a build-version contract to reject incompatible gameplay implementations. Mismatching peers fail closed. Spawn envelopes carry bounded scalar metadata, not scene paths or objects. Nested [Superposition] components receive stable per-instance keys. Ownership uses the authenticated client identity associated with a live connection, while recipient and visibility APIs use connection-generation peer IDs.

method.name: despawn
method.description: Server-only: retires the membership entity and local instance. Nested property entities are retired with the scene. Returns an error for a stale or foreign handle.

method.name: get_entity_for_node
method.description: Returns the membership handle for a spawned scene root or its descendant, or 0 if the node is outside this spawner's live instances.

method.name: get_owner_client_id
method.description: Returns the authenticated owner client ID stored with a live membership entity, or -1 for server ownership or an absent entity. This is not a connection-generation peer ID.

method.name: get_scene_fingerprint
method.description: Returns the deterministic scene manifest digest used by the compatibility handshake. Matching local prefab mappings, resource identity, node structure, declared script interfaces and nested property schemas are required. This is an interface compatibility check, not script implementation authentication; enforce your build version through the native game protocol.

method.name: get_session
method.description: Returns the currently bound session, or null while unconfigured.

method.name: get_spawned_node
method.description: Returns the live local scene root for [param entity], or null if absent or retired.

method.name: get_statistics
method.description: Returns local instance and lifecycle counters, schema fingerprint and the latest error. Counters describe this spawner, not transport acknowledgment or gameplay bandwidth.

method.name: has_entity
method.description: Returns whether this spawner currently owns a live local instance for [param entity].

method.name: is_peer_compatible
method.description: Returns whether the current connection-generation [param peer] has completed a matching scene handshake. Reconnects must negotiate again.

method.name: set_session
method.description: Explicitly binds a native session and retires previous local instances and server membership bindings. An automatic provider can replace this binding when [member session_path] or an ancestor [SuperpositionWorld] is used.

method.name: set_visible
method.description: Server-only: changes membership visibility for one live [param peer]. Hiding removes the client's local instance and nested property entities; re-entry creates a fresh instance with current baselines. Visibility changes retain the same server membership identity.

method.name: spawn
method.description: Server-only: creates a membership entity and local instance for an allowlisted [param prefab_id]. [param owner_peer] is a currently admitted server peer ID, or -1 for server ownership; its authenticated client identity is stored with the instance. [param data] allows at most 16 string keys (64 UTF-8 bytes each), with null, Boolean, integer, finite float, finite Vector3 or strings of at most 256 UTF-8 bytes. The complete envelope must fit 4096 bytes. Returns a positive entity handle on success or 0 and [signal spawn_error] on failure. Metadata is attached as superposition_spawn_data and passed to [signal spawned].

method.name: synchronize
method.description: Advances schema negotiation and reconciles local instances with native membership entities. The node performs this automatically each frame. Invalid or mismatching envelopes produce [signal spawn_error].

members.member: Native entity kind reserved for this spawner's membership envelopes. Keep it distinct from property component kinds and other spawners.
Maximum number of locally tracked instances, from 1 to 4096. Native session entity capacity and transport quotas also apply.
Shared namespace for this spawner's membership envelopes and RPC routing. Use a unique key for each independent spawner in one session, matching across peers.
One to 64 trusted prefab resources with unique IDs and nonnull PackedScenes. Configure the same scene manifest on all peers.
Optional session provider node. With an empty path, discovers the nearest ancestor exposing get_session(), normally [SuperpositionWorld].
Local parent under which replicated scene roots are instantiated. Must resolve inside the running scene.

signal.name: despawned
signal.description: Emitted when a local instance is retired, including visibility removal and session replacement.

signal.name: peer_schema_checked
signal.description: Emitted after checking a peer's manifest, with the compatibility result. False prevents that peer's membership replication.

signal.name: spawn_error
signal.description: Emitted for invalid configuration, unauthorized operations, malformed membership data or lifecycle failures. Inspect the error and message before retrying.

signal.name: spawned
signal.description: Emitted after a local scene root is instantiated and its nested replication components are bound. [param data] is validated spawn metadata.
